recorded_by: Claude Code, at the investigator's written instruction of 2026-10-06

timing.statement: Specified before any translated judging and before any translated-arm result existed or was examined.

primary_analysis.statement: The primary analysis includes all six D-TR-2 identity translations in the translated arm, judged as-is, per decision C1 (engineering/provenance/C1_IDENTITY_TRANSLATION_DECISION_2026-10-06.json).

robustness_analysis.name: exclude-six identity sensitivity
robustness_analysis.definition: Repeat the primary translated-arm quantities after excluding the six records with translation_identity == true (the IDs listed in decision C1). Every other rule is identical to the primary analysis: estimators, interval method, denominators, missing-data handling and reporting.
robustness_analysis.role: Robustness only. It is reported alongside the primary analysis and never replaces it. It does not redefine any estimand, does not change the statistical plan (D-PG-1 to D-PG-6, sensitivity analyses S1 to S5), and adds no threshold or decision rule.
robustness_analysis.reporting: Report with the same prominence whether or not it agrees with the primary result, label it 'pre-specified robustness analysis', and state the number of excluded records.
robustness_analysis.selection_variable: translation_identity (persisted on each translated judge output and analysis row)
